question_themes.theme: Take-home: build a small web API
examples: Build an events API with POST and GET endpoints for account events
Walk through your thought process on the assessment
What would you do with more time?
Reviewers noted an emphasis on testing in the take-home

question_themes.theme: Live coding at medium data-structures level
examples: Claimed by one commercial prep site only; not confirmed by candidate reports

tips: Write tests for the take-home and say why you chose them.
Keep notes while you build the take-home so you can explain decisions and trade-offs afterwards.
Prepare STAR stories for feedback, conflict and failure; use real coaching and school examples.
Know the basics of authentication and why a password manager cares about security, since the product is security software.
notes: Low confidence. No reports specific to intern or co-op roles were found; the evidence is a handful of junior and full-time developer reports plus one commercial prep site. Formats vary by team. Concepts are inferred from the take-home format (API building) and are not confirmed coding-question topics. Confirm the format with the recruiter.
